text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Almond Eye paid a visit to the 
junior club she used to attend as a child.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's just like the race outfit! 
Ehehe, it's so pretty~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you! It's my favorite racing 
silk, after all. I make sure to take good 
care of it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Someday, every one of you will definitely 
get to wear your very own Racewear. So 
keep working hard on your training!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Ai-chan. Everyone was 
absolutely thrilled thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is all mine! To think I'd be 
able to visit the club I went to as a 
child like this.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Really, it hasn't changed a bit, has it? 
...Ah, that tree! We used to play tag 
around there all the time."

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's right. Come to think of it, 
I found something nostalgic. Would you 
like to take a look if you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Look at this drawing! Well, do you 
remember it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Is this...?! Ah, so nostalgic~! It's the 
drawing I made when I was little, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"We all drew pictures of our future selves 
and put them up at the club, didn't we? 
Wow, I can't believe you kept it all this 
time...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a crayon drawing of Almond Eye 
running with all her might in a race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye in the painting was wearing an 
idol-like outfit— and suddenly, I realize 
something.
choice_data_list:
This looks kind of similar to your racing 
outfit...

This looks kind of like your racing 
outfit...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh, you noticed? That's right! You see, I—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I've been thinking about my racewear 
design foreeever since back then, you 
know!"

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Ai-chan was still so small back 
then... It was right around when she first 
started running, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"She really... hasn't changed since way 
back when. Always, always looking straight 
ahead—"

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-chan, how about some drawing~? ...Oh 
my, how lovely! Is this your racing 
outfit?"

text_block_list.name: Young Ai
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm definitely, deee-finitely gonna 
run in this outfit! And then—

text_block_list.name: Young Ai
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna beat those big sisters who were 
running on TV!"

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? You saw me running on TV—"

text_block_list.name: Young Ai
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume running in the Twinkle 
Series!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...At first, I thought she was just an 
innocent girl. But—

text_block_list.name: Young Ai
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! Not yet, not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ai-chan! Please stop already! 
Finishing the exact same training course 
as the pros is just reckless...!

text_block_list.name: Young Ai
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh...! No, I won't give up! I've 
definitely, definitely decided I'm 
reaching the goal!!

text_block_list.name: Young Ai
text_block_list.text:
"The big sister on TV said so, after 
all...! She said she runs this every, 
single, day...――"

text_block_list.name: Young Ai
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'll do it too...! I don't 
want to lose...! I'm definitely, 
definitely going to win...!"

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea she hated losing that 
much... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... For causing so much trouble 
back then...

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's quite all right. If anything, 
it's deeply moving. Ai-chan, what you said 
back then... you truly made it come 
true...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, I let my guard down... To think 
you'd find out about my childhood."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Sorry, I didn't mean anything bad by it.
Sorry, I didn't mean it in a bad way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just... thought you were amazing. I mean 
it from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she's been like that 
ever since we first met.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just because I hate leaving it as a loss. 
Taking on the challenge overseas for that 
reason alone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's just the kind of fiercely 
competitive Umamusume Almond Eye is.
choice_data_list:
You haven't changed a bit since you were 
little, huh.

You haven't changed at all since you were 
little, have you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That may be true, but... is it really 
that strange?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I've always, always loved winning! That's 
all there is to it."
choice_data_list:
Those feelings really dwell within your 
racing outfit, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! The reason I wear this 
Racing Racewear has never changed, not 
back then and not now.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who I'm up against, I'll win— 
together with this racing outfit!"
choice_data_list:
Is there a special meaning behind that red 
ribbon?
You're shining so bright it's dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as you can see. The main highlight 
of this ribbon is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: How cute!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“This is my special racing outfit... After 
all, cuteness is something I want to 
cherish too♪”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right? The vivid sky blue, the 
sparkling accessories... I put so much 
care into every detail.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted my racing outfit to be dazzling, 
just like the world looks when you win!"
